reason: node-forge <=1.4.0 RSA signature-verification flaw; no patched release is available as of 2026-10-21. Present only in word-addin devDependencies through office-addin-dev-certs -> mkcert and office-addin-debugging -> office-addin-dev-settings -> @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli -> @microsoft/teamsfx-core. Their local certificate helpers generate/sign certificates and parse local key/certificate files; they do not call the vulnerable signature verifier. The production add-in image contains only the static bundle and server.mjs (word-addin/Dockerfile), not these development dependencies. REMOVE WHEN: node-forge publishes a patched release and these chains can resolve it; reassess if the dependency gains a production or signature-verification caller.

braces <=3.0.3 stack-exhaustion DoS through deeply nested brace patterns; no patched release exists as of 2026-10-21 (3.0.3 is the latest braces). Present only in devDependencies: frontend through eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch, and word-addin through webpack-dev-server -> http-proxy-middleware -> micromatch (`npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty in every workspace). Those callers expand lint globs and dev-proxy path patterns written in this repository's own config, never user or document input, and neither tool ships in a production image. REMOVE WHEN: braces publishes a patched release (or micromatch drops braces) and these chains resolve it; reassess if braces gains a production caller.
